title: Fallback Variant Compatibility Sentinel: Tokenizer, KV Context & Tooling Maintenance
creator: Rhea Patel
description: Maintain and evolve the compatibility matrix used by smart routing for selecting fallback model variants. Focus areas: tokenizer/tokenization parity, KV cache context alignment (context length, prefix handling), and developer tooling/SDK compatibility for fallbacks. This ticket creates an automated sentinel that (1) detects regression windows across variants when we roll models or apply quantization, (2) produces actionable remediation steps, and (3) wires alerts into the Console routing dashboard and paging policy.
background: Recent canary rollouts of variant-x.3 and quantized variants uncovered silent tokenization drift and context-prefix mismatches causing incorrect completions when the router falls back across regions/tier. Existing matrices are manually curated and lag changes to tokenizer upgrades and kv cache semantics. This causes production incidents where responses are garbled or latent due to rematerialized KV caches.
goals: Implement a nightly sentinel job that runs interoperability checks across active variant combinations
Automate tokenizer parity checks (token counts, boundary tokens, special token handling) against canonical fixtures
Verify KV cache compatibility for prefix/offset semantics and produce a delta report
Expose sentinel results in Console and wire high-severity regressions to oncall
Define and automate rollback / routing mitigation playbooks when incompatibilities are detected
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel runs nightly and produces a machine-readable CSV/JSON report for all deployed variant pairs
Tokenization parity coverage >= 95% on production prompt corpus (sampled) with clear failure classification
KV compatibility test includes prefix-preservation, offset-realignment, and cache warm-start reproducibility checks
Console shows sentinel health and an incidents panel with links to remediation PRs or routing policies
Alerting policy created: P1 regressions page oncall, P2 create ticket; false-positive rate < 10% after tuned heuristics

rollout_plan: 1) Merge sentinel core and enable in staging 2) Run 2-week shadow mode comparing sentinel results to manual audits 3) Enable nightly in prod with low-threshold alerts for first 72 hours 4) After stabilization, flip to strict alerts and automated ticketing
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: High false-positive rate due to noisy production prompt corpus -> Mitigation: use multi-tier heuristics and label-known-exempt prompts
Risk: Nightly runs create load on testpool -> Mitigation: cadence throttling and sample prioritization based on recent rollout churn
Risk: Fixtures get stale -> Mitigation: automated fixture-refresh workflow tied to tokenizer or model-commit changes with mandatory review
